in_marathi.name: Ilaa
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ilaa हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Ilaa is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Ila', which means 'illusion' or 'desire'. It is also associated with the goddess Ila Devi, who is believed to bestow fertility and prosperity.
